title: The Rooted Life Goes Public
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: The greatest letter on the supremacy of Christ ever written does not end with a platform. It ends with a shackle, a list of ordinary names, and grace. Week six takes everything the first five weeks built and walks it into the house, the workday, the prayer closet, and the mouth. Paul writes a household code and then detonates it, handing the powerful a Lord instead of a license. He asks a church to pray for a door and not a key. And he closes with a runaway slave and a man who quit, and calls both of them useful. The test of this series was never whether you enjoyed it. The test is whether the Christ we have been preaching for six weeks shows up in the room where nobody claps.
subtitle: Colossians Week 6
